treats.name: Orchard Apple
treats.description: Crisp red orchard slices from Cloverhollow Market.
treats.useLine: Fae shares crisp Orchard Apple slices. Fresh and crunchy!
treats.favouriteLine: Ooh, Orchard Apple! Their absolute favourite! They munch happily!

treats.name: Fish Cracker
treats.description: Savoury little fish-shaped crackers from Cloverhollow Market.
treats.useLine: Fae shares a crunchy Fish Cracker. Tasty and salty!
treats.favouriteLine: Crunchy Fish Crackers! Their favourite! Tail, wings, or flippers wiggle with joy!

treats.name: Berry Swirl Cone
treats.description: Double-scoop bubblegum-berry cone from the Ice Cream Shop.
treats.useLine: Fae shares a chilly Berry Swirl Cone. Sweet and refreshing!
treats.favouriteLine: A Berry Swirl Cone! Their favourite scoop! Every bit of fizz melts into a smile!

treats.name: Cozy Cocoa Sundae
treats.description: Warm fudge and marshmallow swirl from the Ice Cream Shop.
treats.useLine: Fae shares a Cozy Cocoa Sundae. Warm, sweet, and soothing!
treats.favouriteLine: A Cozy Cocoa Sundae! Their favourite! Warmth washes all the fizz right away!
